summary: NatWest Group plc files Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market repurchases under its existing share buyback programme from 20-24 April 2026. Shares are bought from UBS AG, London Branch across LSE, CHIX, and BATE venues at an aggregate volume-weighted average price ranging from ~582.6 GBp down to ~575.4 GBp. The bought shares will be cancelled; post-settlement treasury shares total ~194.3M with ~8.0B shares in issue. The buyback was announced previously on 16 February 2026 and follows ongoing capital return programme. Watch for continuation of daily updates and reduction in shares outstanding.
